title: Complete Roguelite Quality Profile
description: Thirty-nine classified qualities for coherent roguelite design; each may be required, optional, or not applicable with rationale.

items.title: Great story
items.guidance: Define compelling themes, memorable characters, and meaningful discoveries when narrative applies.

items.title: Infinite replayability
items.guidance: Runs remain fresh through encounters, choices, builds, and challenges.

items.title: Strong roguelite structure
items.guidance: Each run includes controlled randomness, risk, failure, and a reason to retry.

items.title: Permanent upgrades
items.guidance: Lasting unlocks or options between runs are useful and bounded.

items.title: Base building
items.guidance: If selected, the hub grows through useful services, characters, upgrades, and story.

items.title: Multiple playable characters
items.guidance: If selected, characters have distinct mechanics, strengths, weaknesses, and progression.

items.title: Great boss fights
items.guidance: Bosses are memorable, mechanically distinct, readable, and fair.

items.title: Huge enemy variety
items.guidance: Enemy roles and behaviors create useful variety within the release budget.

items.title: Well-designed stages
items.guidance: Stages are readable, varied, strategic, and rewarding to explore.

items.title: Great effects and animations
items.guidance: Movement, attacks, abilities, impacts, and events have expressive feedback.

items.title: Great visuals
items.guidance: The release has a clear, attractive, and recognizable visual identity.

items.title: Smooth controls
items.guidance: Movement, aim, dodge, attack, and interaction are responsive and precise.

items.title: Well-balanced gameplay
items.guidance: Characters, enemies, weapons, upgrades, and difficulty have explicit targets and tuning ranges.

items.title: Great level and build progression
items.guidance: Runs regularly unlock meaningful power and new strategies.

items.title: Engaging in-game sound
items.guidance: Music, combat, environment, voice, and UI sound support action and atmosphere.

items.title: Strong core gameplay loop
items.guidance: Fighting, exploring, rewards, upgrades, and new runs are satisfying as a connected loop.

items.title: Meaningful player choices
items.guidance: Weapons, routes, characters, upgrades, and rewards present real trade-offs.

items.title: Build variety and synergy
items.guidance: Abilities, equipment, items, and effects combine through explicit interaction rules.

items.title: Fair but challenging difficulty
items.guidance: Challenge avoids unavoidable damage, unfair surprises, and empty health inflation.

items.title: Clear enemy and boss telegraphs
items.guidance: Dangerous attacks are recognizable, learnable, and reactable.

items.title: Strong combat feedback
items.guidance: Hits, criticals, blocks, dodges, parries, and abilities communicate impact accessibly.

items.title: Good pacing
items.guidance: Combat, exploration, story, upgrades, and downtime sustain attention without exhaustion.

items.title: Rewarding risk versus reward
items.guidance: Optional danger offers proportionate and understandable rewards.

items.title: Distinct character design
items.guidance: Characters change play patterns rather than only statistics.

items.title: Interesting weapons and abilities
items.guidance: Equipment differs in range, rhythm, mechanics, strengths, weaknesses, and tactics.

items.title: Smart enemy combinations
items.guidance: Enemy groups create tactical situations through complementary roles.

items.title: Procedural generation with structure
items.guidance: Generators, pools, weights, constraints, and seeds produce intentional readable stages.

items.title: Secrets and discovery
items.guidance: Selected secrets, routes, events, lore, bosses, and rewards encourage exploration.

items.title: Satisfying economy
items.guidance: Currencies stay useful, understandable, rewarding, and do not require excessive grinding.

items.title: Good onboarding
items.guidance: New rules arrive naturally without excessive tutorial load.

items.title: Clear user interface and information
items.guidance: Health, damage, effects, objectives, choices, currencies, and resources are understandable.

items.title: Accessibility options
items.guidance: Remapping, subtitles, text size, color, aim, effects, and difficulty support are classified.

items.title: Reliable saving and run recovery
items.guidance: Crashes or interruptions do not erase accepted permanent or recoverable progress.

items.title: Strong technical performance
items.guidance: Frame rate, input latency, loading time, stability, and bug budgets are enforced.

items.title: Worthwhile endgame
items.guidance: Selected difficulty modifiers, routes, bosses, achievements, or builds extend mastery.

items.title: Respect for player time
items.guidance: Run length, grind, repetition, collection, and unskippable sequences stay within budgets.

items.title: Unique identity
items.guidance: Theme, mechanics, atmosphere, art, or structure clearly distinguish the game.

items.title: Emotional payoff
items.guidance: Progression, relationships, discoveries, victories, defeats, and endings create intended emotional beats.

items.title: Consistency between systems
items.guidance: Story, combat, progression, hub, visuals, and sound support one coherent experience.
